neighbours.label: the token 'its'/'Its' without a leading space (Its at a clause start after a quote or newline, -its- inside names like Solzhenitsyn)
fire: We read novels by Solzhenitsyn in the Russian class.
The guide said, "Its walls are older than the town."
The paper was written by Itskovich and colleagues.
Her note read: "Its fine, dont worry about me."
The exile of Solzhenitsyn shocked many readers.
The sign on the box said "Its fragile" in red letters.
My friend texted "Its too late to call now."
A biography of Solzhenitsyn appeared in 1984.
quiet: We read novels by Tolstoy in the Russian class.
The guide said the walls are older than the town.
The paper was written by Ivanov and colleagues.
Her note read: "It is fine, do not worry about me."
The exile of Brodsky shocked many readers.
The sign on the box said the contents were fragile.
My friend texted that it was too late to call.
A biography of Pasternak appeared in 1984.
